plugins.name: super-ralph
plugins.description: Design-first autonomous development workflow. /design produces implementation-ready epics with [STORY]/[BE]/[FE]/[INT] sub-issues. v0.11.0 adds --local mode (write entire plan to a single markdown file, skip GitHub) and /improve-design (single-prompt adjustments to existing designs). Fire-and-forget build → review → verify → release pipelines. Domain-aware repair with hotfix flow.

plugins.name: forth-ai-harness
plugins.description: Technical-cofounder-in-a-plugin for ForthAI Work. Eighteen slash commands carry a rough idea from discovery to a merged, deployed, polished product: /finit /fbrainstorm /fspec /fdesign /fbuild /fpolish /ftest /ffix /flaunch /fship, plus /fautopilot (AIPA autopilot), /fverify (PO dashboard + verify mode), /fretro and /fdream (cross-project learning), daily-ritual /fgm /fgn, /fdashboard (run the PO dashboard in local Docker), and /fhelp. Each command is a convergence loop with polish-exhaustion enforced, optionally pairing Claude with Codex via --codex (full Claude-only mode supported). /fautopilot is an AIPA run-loop with an engine-evaluated READ→DRY_RUN→COMMIT two-phase-write gate (human approval non-bypassable). On-demand domain packs (AIPA, enterprise-integration ERP/CRM connectors, comms-platforms WhatsApp/Telegram/Slack/WeChat-Work/Lark, finance intl+China) plug in with zero always-loaded cost. GitHub is SSoT (Milestones + Issues); artifacts are AI-readable markdown.
